# StayGlobal

> Book verified shortlet apartments across Nigeria. Guests see power, water and security up front, and payment is held until check-in.

StayGlobal (Stay) lists local hosts' shortlets and partner stays in one search. Prices are per night in naira. The exact address is shared after payment.

## Pages

- [Stays](/): Search and browse shortlets by place, dates and guests.
- [Map](/explore): Every stay as a price pin on a map (approximate areas only).
- [Shortlets in Lekki](/stays-in/lekki): Example area page.
- [Guides](/guides): Simple guides to picking and booking a shortlet.
- [List your place](/list-your-place): How hosts list a shortlet.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms and conditions.
- [Privacy](/privacy-policy): Privacy policy.

## Optional

- [How Stay protects your payment](/guides/how-stay-protects-your-payment): Payment hold and refund rules.
